主要内容: On July 23, 2018, Blonder Tongue Laboratories, Inc. (NYSE American: BDR) appointed Ronald V. Alterio as Vice President-Engineering and Chief Technology Officer. The appointment took effect on the same date, with Alterio reporting directly to Bruce Gureck, the Executive Vice President and Chief Operating Officer. He will initially lead Engineering, Product Management, and Project Management functions. Alterio, a degreed software engineer with extensive telecommunications experience, has led successful development teams for over 15 years. Prior to joining Blonder Tongue, he spent 18 years at Pace plc, rising to Senior Vice President of Engineering. The company granted him an employment inducement award of non-qualified stock options to acquire up to 150,000 shares of common stock, subject to time-based vesting conditions. One third of the aggregate inducement award (50,000 shares) will vest on each of the next three one-year anniversaries of his effective date of employment, provided he remains an active employee. The inducement award contains acceleration provisions in the event of a change in control. The award was made outside the 2016 Employee Equity Incentive Plan and approved by the Compensation Committee under the NYSE American Company Guide, Section 711(a).
